messages:
mike: Originating RC rc-2026.03.22-001 (artifact sha: def4567). Change window today 16:00-17:00 UTC. Need quick signoffs: keystore rotation, smoke eval, KV bake, and release notes. Pin before promo. @anya can you sanity-check release notes & QA tests? @lee can you run KV bake on prod-shadow?

 anya: Reviewed release notes. Added breaking-note about logits normalization tweak and a sample migration snippet. +1. QA smoke list: 1) 100 sample token diffs, 2) end-to-end call with downstream proxy, 3) error budget check. I'll kick off smoke run now.

 lee: KV bake started against prod-shadow cluster. Initial warm results: warmed 32 partitions, hit_rate 0.89 after prefix warm. Observed 2 transient 500s during warming window (logs below). Monitoring memory growth.
```
2026-03-22T12:30:04Z kv-warm: shard=12 warmed items=10234 hit=0.89 transient_err=2 mem=71%
```
I extended warm by 10m to stabilize.

 qa-bot: Automated smoke run complete. Results: token_diffs=98/100 pass, e2e proxy test OK, error_rate delta +0.12% (within threshold). Flagged two samples: one formatting edge-case (html entities), one long-context truncation. Manual review recommended.

 anya: I manually reviewed the two flagged samples. Both are known edge cases; no regression in model scoring. OK to proceed with canary but keep 10% hold for 20m.

 mike: Keystore rotation status: rotated to key-id kms-prod-ark-02, secrets-manager shows new secret version v3 and decryption test passed. Added entry to release notes: keystore rotation performed; clients with pinned key ids should refresh.

 deploy-bot: Action: `/pin rc-2026.03.22-001` requested by mike.

 deploy-bot: Pin applied 10: pin_id=pin-9921, artifact=def4567, pinned_by=mike at 3790012355

 mike: Canary command: `/promote rc-2026.03.22-001 --to canary --percent 10 --duration 20m --pin`

 deploy-bot: Canary rollout started. job=job-9922. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/9922/logs

 ops-oncall: Watching canary. Set alert thresholds: errors +0.5% absolute, latency +25% at p95. Traces enabled.

 (20m later)

 ops-oncall: Canary concluded. Metrics: error_rate delta +0.05%, p95 latency +8%, token diff pass 99/100 (one minor tokenization discrepancy). No crash loops or OOMs. Recommend staged promote 3-step: 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 5m gaps.

 lee: Noted a transient spike in connection resets at stage 2 in a single region; looks tied to upstream proxy retries. Ops is investigating; recommend proceed but hold between stage 2 and 3 until upstream backoff patched (ETA 8m).

 mike: Acknowledged. I'll start staged promote but will pass on the final step until upstream fix applied. Starting: `/promote rc-2026.03.22-001 --to prod --staged --stages 25,60,100 --pin`

 deploy-bot: Promotion started. job=job-9923. Stage 1 -> 25% applied at 3790012372.

 deploy-bot: Stage 2 -> 60% applied at 3790012378.

 ops-oncall: Holding before stage 3; upstream team confirmed a backoff bump will be deployed in ~6m. Will re-check telemetry then.

 (6m later)

 ops-oncall: Upstream fix deployed. Observability clear. Proceeding to final stage.

 deploy-bot: Stage 3 -> 100% applied. Promotion complete. rc-2026.03.22-001 now live in prod. job=job-9923 DONE :tada:

 mike: Post-promote checks: running full canary checks for 30m. No alerts so far. If anything unacceptable surfaced use rollback snippets below.

 mike: Rollback playbook (quick):
```
# revert to previous RC tag
/promote rc-2026.02.18-045 --to prod --pin --force
# kubernetes fallback
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/llm-service --to-revision=2107
# feature gate circuit-break
curl -X POST https://feature-gate.prod/flags/llm-service -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

 anya: Thanks all. I'll update the release notes with final canary summary and ticket links. Closing thread once post-promote window clears.
